description: This file contains the implementation of a database driver class 'ADODB_informix72' for connecting and interacting with Informix 7.2 databases, along with related recordset handling class 'ADORecordset_informix72'. It includes methods for establishing connections, executing queries, managing transactions, fetching metadata, and handling BLOB data specifically for Informix.

classes.name: ADODB_informix72
classes.description: A class providing connection management, query execution, transaction control, and metadata retrieval specific to Informix 7.2 databases.

classes.name: ADORecordset_informix72
classes.description: A class for handling recordset results retrieved from Informix 7.2 database queries, supporting navigation and data fetching.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Fetches version and description info of the connected Informix database.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from the last insert operation.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last SQL operation.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from database operations.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for columns in a specified table.

methods.name: MetaForeignKeys
methods.description: Fetches foreign key relationships for a specified table.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field with new data.

methods.name: BlobDecode
methods.description: Decodes a BLOB based on its ID.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection to Informix.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with optional bound parameters.
